coder_notes: Observational-style biomarker/omics study registered with phase NA; no drug administered to patients. IDH-wildtype appears in the conditions field and the exclusion criteria require a 2021 WHO diagnosis; listed as an eligibility biomarker defining GBM (never candidate-matched).
